note: 16 base scenarios: 4 provenance, 4 typed, 4 repeated-failure (B2-lite: the training episode is supplied as a memory; transfer is a closed-choice decision), 4 negative controls. Task wording never states the memory rule (design §11). Type semantics are declared per scenario before any variant sees it. Gold governing state names a memory id; gold action is one of the task's choices. Authority values are scenario-declared and the same for every variant.
